instruction: Complete the task using the batch-capable scripting and fabrication-output interfaces of Altium Designer 17.0.6. The native four-layer PCB `demo.PcbDoc`, `demo.pcb.json`, `art_param.json`, and `violations.json` are on the desktop. Generate artwork outputs. Requirements: - Write `gerbers.zip`, `photoplot.log`, and `fixes.json`. - `gerbers.zip` must contain one `<film>.gbr` file for every film requested by `art_param.json`, with no nested paths. Map TOP, GND, POWER, and BOTTOM to the corresponding copper layers in `demo.PcbDoc`. Every member must contain actual image-producing draws, flashes, or regions, not only headers/comments. - Use the requested Gerber RS-274X units. - `photoplot.log` must summarize the count and names of all generated films and contain no fatal/error result. - `fixes.json` must map every known violation ID: use `reviewed_<type>` for errors and `accepted_<type>_warning` for warnings. [Software] For this task, the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
